description: Lead triage for a short-let unit. The first eleven cases are the owner's worked examples from sweeping Nairobi WhatsApp groups, verbatim; the rest pin the rules behind them. Dates resolve against `now` in the profile's time zone.

cases.name: seeking, unit, area and tonight
cases.message: Anyone with a 1br in Westlands for tonight?

cases.name: naomba with a Swahili date range
cases.message: Naomba 1 bedroom Westlands tarehe 15 mpaka 18

cases.name: on behalf of a client, nights from a weekday
cases.message: Client anataka one bedroom around Parklands, 3 nights from Friday

cases.name: tonight, no location, a budget
cases.message: Nahitaji keja ya kulala usiku wa leo, budget 5k

cases.name: a landmark for Westlands, a bare day range
cases.message: Nauliza, kuna mtu ana one bedroom karibu na Sarit? 20-22

cases.name: a classic listing
cases.message: 1 BEDROOM WESTLANDS ✅ Furnished ✅ Ksh7000/night 📞 0712…

cases.name: iko ... available is offering
cases.message: Iko 1br Kilimani available from 12th, DM

cases.name: seeking, but two bedrooms
cases.message: Any bnb 2 bedroom Kilimani this weekend?

cases.name: seeking, but out of the area
cases.message: Who has a place in Kasarani for the weekend?

cases.name: selling a car
cases.message: Guys nauza gari, 1.2M

cases.name: seeking a cleaner, not a place
cases.message: Anyone know a good cleaner for airbnb Westlands?

cases.name: a studio is a weak match
cases.message: Looking for a studio in Kilimani 2 nights from tomorrow

cases.name: any named area in range makes it a lead
cases.message: Anyone with a 1br in Westlands or Kasarani?

cases.name: a borderline area is a lead, flagged
cases.message: Need a 1 bedroom in Karen this weekend

cases.name: right unit, wrong city
cases.message: Natafuta 1br Nyali kesho

cases.name: a day already passed means next month
cases.message: need 1br westlands 5th to 7th

cases.name: may is a word before it is a month
cases.message: I may need a 1 bedroom in Westlands for 3 nights from Friday

cases.name: a budget beside a seeking verb is still seeking
cases.message: Nina 6k, natafuta one bedroom Westlands leo

cases.name: 01:30 in Nairobi is still the 10th, though UTC says the 9th
cases.message: Natafuta 1br westlands leo usiku

cases.name: no verb either way is not a lead, though the report lists it
cases.message: 1br westlands leo usiku
